title: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Thinking pose
scenes.purpose: Introduce the consistent cel character in a thinking key pose against a navy/teal stripe beat field
visuals: Full-length character, eyes up, hand at chin, cream cutout edge
Stationary navy field with teal diagonal stripe panel and scanline grain

beats.development: Held thinking pose; the stage is set with the copy already readable

scenes.title: Punch-in spark
scenes.purpose: Scale jump to a bust close-up card on a coral colour card for the moment of inspiration
visuals: Hard-cut close-up card with wide eyes, open mouth and sparkle lines
Card settles from 0.9 to 1.0 scale in 0.18s

beats.development: Pose replacement by hard cut to an expressive close-up

scenes.title: Idea connects
scenes.purpose: Cut back to the full shot in the raised-idea key pose; the idea spreads into a network
visuals: Raised arm pose with coral check badge popping
Burst rays and eight connection lines stroke-draw outward
Six nodes snap in as lines arrive

beats.development: Badge pops, rays and links draw, nodes snap in sequence

findings: Three key poses with hard cuts at 0.5s and 1.1s; scene settles at 2.6s, before the 2.7s target
justifiedHolds: 0.4s closing hold for reading the complete composition

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.

Recipe demonstrated: anime pose-card structure from the background review (pose replacement, shot-scale punch-in, flat colour card, cutout edge, stationary scanline grain) applied to the original subject; no source character, wording or branding copied.
